description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timebender, adding {U}.
When Timebender dies, Yedora triggers, returning Timebender from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Timebender by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Timebender's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
